title: get_shop_products_list
description: Verify that GET /shop returns a 200 status with a paged list of products for the public storefront without requiring authentication.

title: get_products_by_category
description: Verify that GET /shop/category/{slug} returns a 200 status with products filtered by the given category slug, and returns 404 for a non-existent category.

title: get_shop_invalid_pagination
description: Verify that GET /shop with per_page=0 returns a 400 Bad Request or validation error due to invalid pagination parameter.

title: search_and_filter_products
description: Verify that GET /shop supports search, brand filtering, price range filtering, and sorting, returning 200 with correct filtered and sorted product lists.

title: search_empty_and_long_query_validation
description: Verify that GET /shop with an empty search query returns either 200 with default product list or 400 if empty query validation is enforced, and that a very long search query returns a 422 Validation Error.

title: add_product_to_cart
description: Verify that POST /cart/add with valid product_id and quantity adds the product to the cart and returns 200 with updated cart payload.

title: add_product_to_cart_exceeding_stock
description: Verify that POST /cart/add with quantity exceeding available stock returns a 409 Conflict with an out-of-stock error.

title: place_order_authenticated
description: Verify that POST /place-an-order with valid Authorization header and required order details creates an order and returns 201 with order_id and summary.

title: place_order_unauthenticated
description: Verify that POST /place-an-order without Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: admin_product_management
description: Verify that authenticated admin can login via POST /admin/login, create a product via POST /admin/product/store with valid data, and retrieve product list via GET /admin/products, and that missing fields or expired JWT return appropriate validation or unauthorized errors.
